run_metadata.model_version_evidence: Fill observed UI label on first submission; do not infer backend snapshot.
run_metadata.selection_policy: All 324 rows of the existing seeded order, without consulting ground truth.
run_metadata.raw_response_policy: Save first completed visible answer verbatim; no retries based on answer correctness or formatting.

metric_policy.scope: Project-defined detailed metrics; not a claim of exact paper evaluation replication.
metric_policy.population: Only structurally valid complete predictions are scored. Missing/invalid/ambiguous predictions are unscored and included in coverage denominator.
metric_policy.conflicts: Unordered vehicle-pair sets. Empty/empty exact match is true; zero micro denominators are null.
metric_policy.actions: Project normalization of author pair decisions: yield if named as yielding in ANY pair, otherwise proceed. stop/slow_down remain distinct and count as mismatches.
metric_policy.priority: Compare relative order only among author non-null ranks. Do not score order of nonconflicting vehicles. Zero applicable vehicles/scenarios gives null.
metric_policy.waiting: Compare full-precision author dataset-level waits. Report all vehicles and author-conflicting vehicles separately.
metric_policy.places: Only coarse location multiset is scored; intersection_center explicitly aliases intersection. No precise spatial GT exists.
metric_policy.explanations: Validate/store text only; no semantic correctness score and no ROUGE claimed.
metric_policy.yield_relations: Not directly scored: archived output schema has per-vehicle actions but no structured yield-to ID.
metric_policy.gt_inconsistency: Retain and report author pair-yield versus global-rank contradictions; score these fields separately, not as a single physical ground truth.
metric_policy.all_fields: All scored structured fields exact (waiting uses declared tolerance), excluding reason/explanation semantics and unranked order; requires consistency checks to pass.
metric_policy.run_metadata: Recorded experiment metadata is not independently verified by evaluator.
